sloka: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितो अस्मि वचने तव ।सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अनुपालयन् ॥४-२७-४४॥
transliteration: śarat kālam pratīkṣiṣye sthito asmi vacane tava ।sugrīvasya nadīnām ca prasādam anupālayan ॥4-27-44॥

translations.english: 'I will wait for autumn. I will stick to your advice while I wait until Sugriva and the rivers are pleased (with moderate flow of water.)
